evidence: All five dimension prompts (render, constraints, functional, polish, visual) and the injected tests/app_context.md describe THIS app and agree with the brief, rules and seed. Template residue: tests/app_context.md has no CHANGE_ME (template app_context.md lines 3/8/12 are CHANGE_ME; task replaces all three: Name HireOps, URL http://localhost:3000, 10 accounts, key screens). Credentials: app_context.md:8 password `Hireops!2026` = instruction.md:17 = hireops_rules.md:11; the 10 accounts/roles in app_context.md:10-19 match instruction.md:17 and seed users (USR-REC1..3 recruiter, USR-MGR1..3 hiring_manager, USR-OBS1 observer, USR-CAN1..3 candidate) exactly, including names. Screens: app_context.md:23-25 (Board per job with Applied, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected; Conversations; Activity; candidate applications view) = instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:42-43, 177. Entities/seed facts quoted in prompts re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (Platform Engineer/Infrastructure/mgr Ingrid, Data Analyst/mgr Bill, Product Designer/mgr Yuki); Platform Engineer Applied order Greta Lindqvist(1), Ade Bello(2), Marco Rossi(3) and Screen Priya Nair(1), Samuel Ortiz(2) (functional prompt.md:25, hro_restart) correct; Noor Haddad's card APP-101 is on Platform Engineer with note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (exact match); Noor's Platform Engineer conversation has 120 messages (app_context.md:30) correct; Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, 3rd message from USR-REC3, so unread 1 (prompt.md:25, hro_unread_counts) correct; Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation exists (APP-201) and its manager is Bill, so the T fallback keeps the Bill/Ingrid access split valid. Rules restated in prompts/criteria match hireops_rules.md: interview places 1-50 integer (0, 51, 2.5 refused), case-insensitive duplicate email per job, one-stage moves, reject not from Hired, reopen only to rejected-from stage, manager limited to Interview/Offer/Hired on own job (Interview->Screen and reopen-from-Screen refused), undo blocked by move/re-order/reject/reopen but not notes, 401 anonymous / 403 role / 404 candidate-not-own, candidate wording table, 30-message pages, seen rules (observer never counts; candidate message seen by recruiter or job's manager), activity excludes notes/messages. Criterion ids referenced by name in the functional prompt (hro_activity_refusals, hro_candidate_linked, hro_restart) and in criteria (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full, hro_undo_conflict, hro_msg_compose, hro_candidate_private, hro_pol_session_resume) all exist in the corresponding judge.toml files. Deliverable/runtime: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 (port 3000 per instruction.md:13); visual prompt.md:14 'No phone layout or theme switching is required' matches instruction.md:11; restart_app usage (functional prompt.md:1, 51) matches the functional judge.toml verifier MCP server. Cross-dimension consistency: polish prompt.md:16 forbids Lena's conversation and visual/polish never move seeded Platform Engineer cards, protecting functional Z's seeded readings regardless of suite order. Sibling residue: grep of all task/tests .md/.toml for colderwater, ticket, invoice, inventory, booking, cart, placeholder, TODO, {{ found nothing; no Pellmoor (recruiting sibling) seed names or 'pellmoor'/'threadline' strings appear anywhere in the task. Adversarial tries: (1) broken app passing because a prompt points at a wrong entity/account - none found; every seeded value the judge is told to expect is correct, so a wrong-data app would be caught rather than credited. (2) Conforming app failing from prompt inaccuracy - closest candidate is that the functional/polish/visual global gate text omits the job 'team' field (prompt.md:11 in each) while hro_gate_shared and hireops_rules.md:27 include it; this does not misdescribe the app (a judge fills a required team field through the UI) and does not make a conforming app fail. Minor clarity observation (not residue, P3, no grading impact found): functional prompt.md:39 says 'As Mei Lin write in this new J2 conversation of Tomas's (not his Data Analyst one)' while the same protocol's fallback substitutes the Data Analyst conversation wherever T names the new J2 conversation; the substitution rule covers it, but the parenthetical reads oddly under fallback. Not exercised at runtime: no configured judge run is cited; this row is a source-accuracy check and needs no runtime measurement.
